name: end_conversation
description: End the conversation when the user is clearly done: says goodbye, thanks you and needs nothing more, or says "ok" or "got it" after you finished. Never while a task is still open or right after you asked a question. The app closes the chat and stops listening for follow-ups.

farewell.description: A short goodbye to say aloud, in the user's language. Empty for a plain "ok".

name: not_for_me
description: The last speech was heard without the wake word and is not addressed to you: people talking to each other, a TV, radio or a phone call. You stay silent and the app keeps listening. Use only for speech marked as heard without the wake word.
